name: electricity
title: Electricity Prices
description: View electricity prices from Nordpool for Nordic & Baltic countries - current price, next 24 hours, cheapest hour
author: tristankrass

commands.name: electricity
commands.title: View Prices
commands.subtitle: Nordpool
commands.description: View current and upcoming electricity prices with smart recommendations

commands.name: price-chart
commands.title: Price Chart
commands.subtitle: Nordpool
commands.description: Visual chart of electricity prices for the next 24 hours

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Menu Bar Price
commands.subtitle: Nordpool
commands.description: Monitor current electricity price in your menu bar

preferences.name: vatRate
preferences.title: VAT Rate (%)
preferences.description: Your country's VAT percentage. Examples: Estonia 24%, Finland 25.5%, Sweden 25%, Norway 25%, Germany 19%, Netherlands 21%

preferences.name: cheapThreshold
preferences.title: Cheap Price Limit
preferences.description: Prices below this (in cents/kWh with VAT) show as GREEN. Typical: 3-8 depending on your market

preferences.name: averageThreshold
preferences.title: Average Price Limit
preferences.description: Prices below this (in cents/kWh with VAT) show as BLUE. Typical: 8-15 depending on your market

preferences.name: highThreshold
preferences.title: High Price Limit
preferences.description: Prices below this show as ORANGE, above shows as RED (expensive). Typical: 15-25 depending on your market
